home.heroDesc: RightsQuest transforms complex legal concepts into fun, engaging quests for kids aged 8-16. Build their confidence and understanding of their rights in a safe, gamified environment.
home.howItWorksDesc: We've broken down essential legal concepts into three simple, engaging steps.
home.step1Desc: Complex topics like privacy, contracts, and digital rights are translated into simple, kid-friendly stories.
home.step2Desc: Apply knowledge immediately through scenario-based games. Make choices and see the consequences in a safe space.
home.step3Desc: Collect badges, level up, and unlock new customizations for their personal avatar as they master new topics.
home.safetyDesc: No direct messaging between users. All content is moderated. Children's personal data is never collected. Every support request goes through structured, safe channels.
home.ctaTitle: Start your child's rights journey today
home.ctaDesc: Join thousands of parents who trust RightsQuest to educate and empower their children.

footer.copyright: © 2026 RightsQuest — SIH 2026. Built for children's rights awareness.
